verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity has a documented API for creating and tracking verification sessions, retrieving results programmatically, and receiving webhook events. The docs themselves say only "most" verification details are accessible programmatically, and Dashboard-side features (reusable Flows, manual status overrides, blocklisting in review tools) are never shown to have API equivalents, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: documented API equivalents for review tools (status override, blocklist) and Flow configuration, an explicit statement of API/UI parity, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can access most verification details programmatically... using your secret key.
This API tracks a verification, from initial creation through the entire verification process, and shows verification results upon completion.
Stripe generates events every time a session changes status.
